moments.title: Bonfire Night Firework Displays
moments.blurb: Guy Fawkes Night is on Thursday, November 5th, with many firework displays and bonfires happening across the UK on the day and throughout the weekend.

source.l: Various UK councils and event organisers

angles.name: National Call Out
angles.copy: Remember, remember the 5th of November! Bonfire Night is this Thursday. Are you heading to a local display or having a bonfire at home? Stay safe and enjoy the fireworks!

angles.name: Local Events Focus (London)
angles.copy: Planning your Bonfire Night? London's skies will be lit up with spectacular displays this weekend! Alexandra Palace and Battersea Park are just two of the big ones. Where are you heading?

angles.name: Local Events Focus (Wales)
angles.copy: Bonfire Night is almost here! What are your plans for Thursday, November 5th? Many communities across Wales are hosting brilliant firework displays this weekend. Let us know where you'll be celebrating!

moments.title: Champions League Matchday 4
moments.blurb: Matchday 4 of the UEFA Champions League continues today and tomorrow, November 3rd and 4th, with several English clubs in action, including Manchester United, Aston Villa, Liverpool, and Manchester City.

angles.name: Tonight's Games
angles.copy: Champions League fever! Tonight, Man Utd take on Roma and Aston Villa face Barcelona. Who are you backing to get the crucial points in Europe?

angles.name: Tomorrow's Action
angles.copy: More Champions League action tomorrow! Liverpool are away to Fenerbahçe and Man City visit RB Leipzig. Big nights for our English teams – predictions?

moments.title: Stevie Wonder at The O2
moments.blurb: Music legend Stevie Wonder is performing at London's O2 Arena tonight, November 3rd, and again on Thursday, November 5th, celebrating 50 years of 'Songs In The Key Of Life'.

angles.name: Tonight's Show
angles.copy: The one and only Stevie Wonder takes to The O2 stage tonight! Celebrating 50 years of 'Songs In The Key Of Life', it's going to be an unforgettable night. Anyone lucky enough to be there?

angles.name: Living Legend
angles.copy: A true living legend! Stevie Wonder is in London for two incredible shows this week. What's your all-time favourite track from 'Songs In The Key Of Life'?

moments.title: Happy 72nd Birthday, Adam Ant
moments.blurb: New Wave icon Adam Ant, born Stuart Leslie Goddard, celebrates his 72nd birthday today, November 3rd.

angles.name: Birthday Shoutout
angles.copy: Happy 72nd birthday to the dandy highwayman himself, Adam Ant! Still looking like a Prince Charming. What's your favourite Adam and the Ants hit?

angles.name: Antmusic Rewind
angles.copy: Antmusic for sex people, Antmusic for ex-people! Celebrating Adam Ant's 72nd birthday today with a blast of his iconic New Wave sound. Which track gets you dancing?

moments.title: Carnaby Street Christmas Lights Switch-On
moments.blurb: London's festive season officially kicks off on Wednesday, November 4th, with the highly anticipated Christmas lights switch-on in Carnaby Street.

angles.name: Festive Kick-Off
angles.copy: The festive season officially begins! Carnaby Street's iconic Christmas lights are switched on tomorrow. Who's ready for some serious festive cheer in London?

angles.name: London Lit Up
angles.copy: Carnaby Street leads the way! Tomorrow, London gets a little brighter with the first major Christmas light switch-on. What are you hoping the theme will be this year?

moments.title: Official UK Singles Chart Update
moments.blurb: The Official UK Singles Chart will announce its latest Top 40 on Friday, November 6th. Who do you think will be battling for the top spot this week?

angles.name: Chart Race
angles.copy: Who's going to be Number 1 this week? The Official UK Singles Chart is updated on Friday – tell us your predictions for the top spot!

angles.name: New Music Friday Prep
angles.copy: New music dropping this Friday and the charts are updating! What new tracks are you hoping to see climb the Official Singles Chart?

moments.title: Happy 67th Birthday, Bryan Adams
moments.blurb: Canadian rock icon Bryan Adams, known for hits like 'Summer of 69' and '(Everything I Do) I Do It for You', turns 67 on Thursday, November 5th.

angles.name: Birthday Rocker
angles.copy: It's a big birthday for Bryan Adams on Thursday – he turns 67! From power ballads to rock anthems, what's your ultimate Bryan Adams track?

angles.name: Iconic Hits
angles.copy: Summer of '69 still sounds as good today! Wishing a very happy 67th birthday to the legendary Bryan Adams on November 5th. What's your favourite lyric?

moments.title: Happy 85th Birthday, Art Garfunkel
moments.blurb: Half of the iconic folk-rock duo Simon & Garfunkel, Art Garfunkel, celebrates his 85th birthday on Thursday, November 5th.

angles.name: Legendary Voice
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the incredible Art Garfunkel! His voice is truly one of a kind. What's your favourite Simon & Garfunkel song?

angles.name: Folk Rock Royalty
angles.copy: Bridge Over Troubled Water, Mrs. Robinson... so many classics! Celebrating Art Garfunkel's 85th birthday on Thursday. What's the first song that comes to mind?

moments.title: Wales v Japan Rugby International
moments.blurb: Wales begin their Autumn Nations Championship campaign against Japan at the Principality Stadium in Cardiff on Saturday, November 7th, with kick-off at 4:40pm.

angles.name: Cymru Kicks Off
angles.copy: Cymru kicks off its Autumn Nations Championship this Saturday! Wales take on Japan at home in Cardiff. Who's heading to the Principality Stadium to cheer on the boys?

angles.name: Autumn Rugby Returns
angles.copy: The Autumn Internationals are back! Wales face Japan this Saturday in Cardiff. Get your scarves ready – it's going to be a big one!

moments.title: England v Australia Rugby International
moments.blurb: England will face Australia in their opening Autumn Nations Championship fixture at Twickenham on Sunday, November 8th, with kick-off at 3:10pm.

angles.name: Twickenham Clash
angles.copy: England vs Australia at Twickenham this Sunday! The Autumn Nations Championship begins with a huge clash. Who's ready for some international rugby action?

angles.name: Red Rose Ready
angles.copy: The Red Rose takes on the Wallabies this Sunday! England's Autumn Internationals kick off with a massive game against Australia. Predictions?

moments.title: Premier League Weekend Fixtures
moments.blurb: This weekend's Premier League action includes Leeds vs Spurs, Arsenal vs Hull, and Fulham vs Newcastle on Saturday, followed by Brighton vs Brentford, Crystal Palace vs Liverpool, and Man Utd vs Aston Villa on Sunday.

angles.name: Weekend Football
angles.copy: Premier League weekend incoming! Big games include Leeds v Spurs and Arsenal v Hull on Saturday, then Man Utd v Aston Villa on Sunday. Which fixture are you most looking forward to?

angles.name: Derby Day Potential
angles.copy: Any local rivalries sparking up this weekend? Plus, Man Utd face Aston Villa and Crystal Palace host Liverpool. Who needs the points most?

moments.title: Regent Street Christmas Lights Switch-On
moments.blurb: Regent Street and St James's will illuminate London with their iconic 'Spirit of Christmas' lights on Thursday, November 5th.

angles.name: Iconic Display
angles.copy: The 'Spirit of Christmas' returns! Regent Street's stunning Christmas lights are switched on this Thursday. Who's planning a trip to see them?

angles.name: Festive Glow
angles.copy: Another London landmark gets its festive glow on Thursday! Regent Street's Christmas lights are always a highlight. What's your favourite part of the display?

moments.title: Happy 81st Birthday, Neil Young
moments.blurb: Legendary Canadian-American singer-songwriter Neil Young, known for his influential work in folk, rock, and country music, celebrates his 81st birthday on Thursday, November 12th.

angles.name: Rock Legend Birthday
angles.copy: A true rock legend turns 81 this Thursday! Happy birthday to the one and only Neil Young. What's your go-to Neil Young anthem?

angles.name: Harvest Moon Vibes
angles.copy: From 'Harvest Moon' to 'Heart of Gold', Neil Young's discography is timeless. Celebrating his 81st birthday on November 12th. What's your favourite album?

moments.title: I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out Of Here! Returns
moments.blurb: The highly anticipated new series of 'I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out Of Here!' kicks off on Monday, November 16th, at 9pm on ITV1 and ITVX, with Ant and Dec returning to host live from Australia.

angles.name: Jungle Countdown
angles.copy: Get ready for the jungle! I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out Of Here! returns Monday, Nov 16th. Who are you hoping to see in the camp this year?

angles.name: Ant & Dec Are Back
angles.copy: Ant and Dec are heading back to Australia! I'm A Celeb is just around the corner. What's the one Bushtucker Trial you'd NEVER do?

moments.title: Oxford Street Christmas Lights: Harry Potter Theme
moments.blurb: Oxford Street's Christmas lights will be switched on Monday, November 9th, with a magical Harry Potter-inspired theme to celebrate the new 'Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone' TV series and a new flagship store.

angles.name: Wizarding Christmas
angles.copy: Accio Christmas cheer! Oxford Street's lights switch on next Monday, Nov 9th, with a magical Harry Potter theme. Who's excited to see the Wizarding World light up London?

angles.name: Magic in London
angles.copy: Oxford Street is getting a magical makeover for Christmas! The lights go on next Monday, with a Harry Potter theme. Are you a Potterhead who'll be there?

angles.copy: The Glasto dream lives on for some, but many missed out as tickets for 2027 are all gone. What's the one artist you'd love to see at Worthy Farm?

moments.title: New BBC TV Shows This November
moments.blurb: BBC One and iPlayer are launching several new shows this November, including the spy drama 'Honey', a new series of 'Shetland', and 'This City Is Ours', a Liverpool gangster drama.

angles.name: Autumn TV Picks
angles.copy: Settling in for some new TV this November? The BBC has a strong line-up, including new spy drama 'Honey' and a fresh series of 'Shetland'. What's on your watchlist?

angles.name: Drama & More
angles.copy: From Cold War thrills to Liverpool gangland tales, the BBC is bringing plenty of drama this month. Plus, Diane Morgan's 'Cunk on Cinema' is coming! Which show will you binge first?
